//: Copy this file to appsettings.json (git-ignored) and fill in real values.
//Secrets: Keys marked [secret] are better kept out of appsettings.json on a dev machine: store them as user secrets (`dotnet user-secrets set "DiscordToken" "..." --project ZenBotCS`), which Program.cs loads after appsettings.json and so override it. User secrets live in your user profile, never in the repo. On a server (Docker/systemd) there is no user-secrets store, so put them in the chmod-600 appsettings.json there.
//CocApiToken: [secret] Official Clash of Clans API key from developer.clashofclans.com. IP-locked: the key only works from the IPs it was created for. On a server with a static IP, create one by hand and leave CocApiAutoProvisionKey false.
//CocApiAutoProvisionKey: Dev-machine convenience for connections without a static IP. When true, the bot logs into developer.clashofclans.com at startup with CocApiEmail/CocApiPassword and (re)creates the key named CocApiKeyName for the current public IP; CocApiToken is then only the fallback if that fails.
//CocApiEmail: [secret] Login e-mail of the developer.clashofclans.com account. Only needed with CocApiAutoProvisionKey.
//CocApiPassword: [secret] Password of that account. Only needed with CocApiAutoProvisionKey - definitely keep this one in user secrets.
//CocApiKeyName: Name of the key that gets replaced on each IP change. Defaults to ZenBotCS-<machine name>. An account holds at most 10 keys.
//CkApiToken: [secret] ClashKing developer token (ck_dev_...). Needed for the Discord-link lookup (/v2/links/shared); the war-history endpoints work without it.
//BotDbConnectionString: [secret] MySQL connection string for the bot database. Use server=mysql under docker compose.
//CocApiCacheConnectionString: [secret] MySQL connection string for the CocApi cache database.
//GoogleSheets: Optional. Only the Google Sheets features need the four keys below: roster sheets in /cwl roster, the CWL data export, the signup dump and RosterSource=Spreadsheet. Leave them empty and everything else works; those commands then report an error.
//PathToGspreadCredentialsOAuth2: Google OAuth2 client JSON with Sheets + Drive access (git-ignored, copied to the output directory on build).
//PathToGspreadToken: Directory where the Google OAuth2 token is cached. Release builds never prompt for a login: authorize once with a Debug build, then copy the token file here.
//CwlRosterTemplateSpreadsheetId: Google Sheet used as the template for CWL rosters.
//RosterSource: Optional. Where CWL roster reads come from: Database (default, the web roster site) or Spreadsheet (the pinned Google Sheet).
//FamilyLeadershipRoleId: Discord role id that gates leadership commands.
//WarGeneralRoleId: Discord role id for war generals.
//StrikeLogChannelId: Optional. Channel where every /strike add and /strike remove is logged. 0 = no log.
//Help: Discord message links shown by /help and the CWL signup help button.
